paper_title: X-Ray Constraints on Dark Photon Tridents
notes: Paper presents 95% C.L. upper limits on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon from 16 years of INTEGRAL/SPI data, constraining the three-photon (trident) decay channel for masses 61-1022 keV. No numerical table is provided; the limit curve is shown in Fig. 4 (epsilon vs m_A'). The text states the limit spans from ~1e-12 down to ~1e-19 over 61-1022 keV. Data points are anchored at the stated endpoint values and log-interpolated using the expected steep mass scaling (Gamma ~ eps^2 m^9 floop with tau limits from Fig. 1), so intermediate values are approximate. Assumes dark photon is all of DM with NFW profile (rho_sun = 0.42 GeV/cm^3, r_s = 9.98 kpc), effective D-factor 1.2e23 GeV/cm^2. This is a decay (indirect detection) search, but DM density assumption is Galactic halo-based, recorded here since the limit scales with the assumed DM distribution. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 6))
